question.text: Let the vectors <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>|</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>|</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>|</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>|</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If the projection of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> on <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is equal to the projection of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> on <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is perpendicular to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>|</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>|</mo></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>…</mo></math>
